indirect_details: His official Yashoda Hospitals profile is https://www.yashodahospitals.com/doctor/malakpet/plastic-surgery/dr-m-v-chandra-mouli/ - the practical detail published there is that he consults by appointment for OPD between 10:00 am and 5:00 pm at Yashoda Hospital, Malakpet, Hyderabad, so an appointment request to the Malakpet plastic surgery OPD naming him and that window is the correct route. A second official page describing him as Consultant Plastic & Cosmetic Surgeon is at https://www.yashodahospitals.com/product/dr-m-v-chandra-mouli/ , and the department-level doctor list is at https://www.yashodahospitals.com/specialities/plastic-reconstructive-surgery/doctors/ . verified_role: Consultant Plastic & Cosmetic Surgeon, Department of Plastic Surgery, Yashoda Hospital, Malakpet, Hyderabad. Previously Assistant Professor at K E M Hospital, Mumbai.
verified_experience: About 14-15 years. The Yashoda profile states 'over 14 years'; the source row says 15 Years. His training timeline supports that when counted as a surgeon: MBBS from MKCG Medical College, Behrampur (2003), MS General Surgery from SCB Medical College, Cuttack (2008), MCh Plastic & Reconstructive Surgery from Seth GS Medical College, Mumbai (2012). One aggregator quotes 'over 10 years', which is a stale figure - see notes.
hni_signals: Twice-super-specialised surgeon (MS General Surgery then MCh Plastic & Reconstructive Surgery) trained at Seth GS Medical College, Mumbai - the KEM Hospital academic complex, one of India's foremost plastic surgery training centres - and he held a faculty post there as Assistant Professor at K E M Hospital, Mumbai before moving to private practice in Hyderabad. A teaching-hospital faculty background is a distinct seniority marker relative to a purely corporate-hospital career. Practises the elective, self-pay, high-margin end of surgery (aesthetic and cosmetic surgery) alongside the technically demanding reconstructive side (microvascular and hand surgery). Member of the Indian Medical Association, the Indian Association of Plastic Surgeons and the Association of Plastic Surgeons of India.
